question: Mr. X is a 67-year-old patient who has been prescribed atorvastatin orally due to high cholesterol levels that have not improved after dietary measures. Among the clinical applications of the HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors we have:

options.opa: They are the drugs of choice in the case of pregnant women.
options.opb: They are drugs of first choice in the treatment of hypertriglyceridemia.
options.opc: They are not effective in the secondary prevention of myocardial infarction.
options.opd: In severe dyslipidemias, in the case of heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, they should be combined with ezetimibe.
options.ope: They are not effective in the secondary prevention of stroke.
